privacy.intro: Your privacy is important to us. NaNSYSTEMS, by Ana Echeverría, is responsible for the data collected on this website (https://nansystems.us). This policy explains what data it collects, what we use it for, who it is shared with, and what you can do about it.
privacy.s1: What data we collect and why
privacy.s1-intro: We only ask for personal data when we need it to assist you, and we collect it with your knowledge, through forms that you choose to submit:
privacy.s1-contact: Contact form: name, email address and message, to answer your inquiry.
privacy.s1-quote: Quote request: name, email address, phone (optional), preferred time to be called, company and job title (optional), comments and the service you are interested in, to prepare and send you a quote.
privacy.s1-news: Newsletter: your email address, to send you technical articles and news. You can ask to be removed at any time.
privacy.s1-tech: Technical data: when you visit the site, the servers that deliver it and the statistics tools receive data such as your IP address, your browser and the pages you visit.
privacy.s1-note: We do not ask for payment details or sensitive data, and we do not sell your personal information.
privacy.s2-intro: We use providers that process data on our behalf; some may do so outside your country of residence:
privacy.s2-netlify: Netlify: hosts the site and receives form submissions, which it notifies to us by email and which are stored in our dashboard.
privacy.s2-dato: DatoCMS: manages the site's texts and images; its servers deliver the images and may log the IP address of whoever downloads them.
privacy.s2-ga: Google Analytics: site usage statistics (see “Cookies and local storage”).
privacy.s2-eq: Equalweb: provides the site's accessibility menu, which loads from its servers.
privacy.s2-end: Apart from these providers, we do not share your personal information with third parties unless the law requires it.
privacy.s3-intro: The site stores the following in your browser:
privacy.s3-theme: remembers whether you chose the light or the dark theme.
privacy.s3-limit: count the recent submissions of each form to curb abuse.
privacy.s3-consent: stores your choice in the cookie notice.
privacy.s3-ga: Google Analytics cookies, to tell visits apart and measure site usage in aggregate.
privacy.s3-eq: The Equalweb accessibility menu may store the options you choose in your browser.
privacy.s3-outro: You can delete or block this data in your browser settings: the site will keep working, although it will forget your preferences. So that Google Analytics does not measure your visit you can also use its opt-out add-on (tools.google.com/dlpage/gaoptout).
privacy.s4-text: We keep your messages and requests for as long as needed to handle them and for the business relationship that results from them, and we delete them when you ask, unless the law requires us to keep them. We protect the data we store by commercially reasonable means to prevent loss, theft, and unauthorized access, use or modification.
privacy.s5-a: You can ask us for access to your data, for its correction or deletion, for removal from the newsletter, and object to its use; depending on where you live, the law may give you further rights. To exercise them, write to us from the
privacy.s5-b: and we will reply within a reasonable time. You are free not to give us your data, although we may then be unable to provide some services.
privacy.s6-text: This site is not directed at minors and we do not knowingly collect data from minors. If you believe a minor has sent us their data, let us know so we can delete it.
privacy.s7-text: The site may link to external sites (for example, social networks and the links to share articles) that we do not operate. We have no control over their content or practices, and we cannot accept responsibility for their privacy policies.
privacy.s8-text: We may update this policy; the date of the latest revision appears at the top of the page. Continued use of the site will be taken as acceptance of the current version. If you have any questions about how we handle your data, feel free to contact us.
privacy.l10: This policy is based on a GetTerms template and was adapted to this site.
